title: Bad locus {e2=0,e1!=0} is DISJOINT from negation/coset (e1=0) -- needs orbit/quadric, not Lam-Leung
evidence: Two-part assessment at PROPER dyadic subgroups mu_n (n=8/16/32/64, beta=4 and 4.5, q==1 mod n with q-1 NOT a power of 2 so a genuine proper/multiple-prime subgroup, n<<sqrt q). Probes scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C081_e2face_disjoint_quadric.py and probe_C081_K_growth.py (exact integer / mod-q). PROVEN PART (disjointness): the core claim e1_eq_zero_of_neg_closed is already axiom-clean in-tree (the comment-57 brick _E2NegationStructure.lean, mirrored by SubsetSumEsymmVanishing.subgroup_sum_eq_zero / NegationClosedSumZero.antipodalConsistent_sum_zero). The disjointness e2_zero_bad_not_neg_closed is its near-trivial contrapositive: -S=S (char!=2) pairs s<->-s with no nonzero fixed point, forcing e1(S)=sum s=0, so e1(S)!=0 ==> S not negation-closed. CONFIRMED EXACTLY by probe (A): at n=8 a=k+2=4 (rho=1/4), of 10 sets with e2=0, exactly 8 have e1!=0 (the bad locus) and 0 of those 8 are negation-closed; the only 2 negation-closed e2=0 sets are precisely the e1=0 (non-bad) ones. So {e2=0,e1!=0} is exactly disjoint from the antipodal/coset world, and the bad locus is non-vacuous -- the redirection 'e2 face is the complement of the Lam-Leung regime' is correct and non-trivial as navigation. REFUTED PART (the attack_plan payload, the only thing that would be a closure): the plan promises K=#dilation-orbits of bad e1-scalars over {e2=0,e1!=0} is O(1) above delta* via 'the quadric's bounded point count'. Both inputs FAIL. (i) The 'complement-quadric' point count #{S subseteq mu_n : |S|=4, e2(S)=0} = 10,52,232,976 at n=8,16,32,64 -- ratio per n-doubling 5.2->4.46->4.21 -> ~Theta(n^2), NOT O(1). (ii) The bad-scalar count K = #{alpha=-1/e1(S)}/n = 1,3,7,15 at n=8,16,32,64 = EXACTLY n/4-1 = Theta(n) at the deep width-4 face -- reproducing comment-57's 'w=4 SATURATED, below delta*' independently from the scalar side. (iii) At the WINDOW INTERIOR (a ~ n/2) the e2=0 face is governed by Lam-Leung antipodal vanishing: rows a=6,7,10 give #e2=0 = 0 (n=8,16), so a finite-quadric point-count argument cannot even reach the prize radius -- the residual count there is the simultaneous-vanishing / BGK object. So the e2-face orbit count welds to the SAME wall as C023 (gcd-dictionary REFUTED), C074 (orbit law PARTIAL->BGK), C041 (single-orbit REFUTED).
honest_note: PROVEN here and in-tree (axiom-clean): the disjointness theorem -- bad locus {e2=0,e1!=0} never touches negation-closed/coset sets, because e1!=0 logically forbids -S=S. This is real and useful as a redirection (don't import Lam-Leung antipodal/Bessel machinery onto the e2 face) but it is essentially the contrapositive of an already-proven one-line involution lemma, not new depth. REFUTED: the attack_plan's K=O(1)-via-bounded-quadric closure. The quadric point count grows (Theta(n^2) at a=4), K grows (Theta(n) at the deep face, exactly n/4-1), and the window interior is empty/Lam-Leung-controlled, so 'bounded quadric point count' is false and cannot certify the e2 face poly. NET: the connection's TRUE statement (disjointness) is proven but shallow; its CLOSURE-bearing statement (K=O(1)) is refuted, identically to the orbit-count cluster C023/C041/C074. Probes are exact but small (n<=64; C(n,k+2) exhaustion infeasible at n=32 window-interior and beyond) -- however the e1=0<=>negation-closed disjointness is a closed-form char!=2 fact (rigorous for all n,q), and the K=Theta(n)/quadric=Theta(n^2) growth is monotone and structural (degree-2 homogeneity e2(gS)=g^2 e2(S) makes the e2=0 variety dilation-invariant of growing dimension), so the inversion is unlikely to flip at prize n=2^30. The deep face is BELOW delta*; the actual prize radius row is the empty/Lam-Leung one, which is the open core. No closure fabricated. The refuted K=O(1)-quadric attack-plan claim belongs in DISPROOF_LOG (joins the C023/C041 orbit-count refutations).
reduced_to: The PROVEN disjointness sharpens the e2-face question to: count the dilation-orbits K of window-INTERIOR bad e1-scalars over {S subseteq mu_n : |S|=k+2, e1(S)!=0, e2(S)=0}, where (unlike the deep width-4 face with K=n/4-1=Theta(n)) the e2=0 variety is sparse/Lam-Leung-controlled. Whether THAT window-interior K is O(1) is the open quantity -- but it is NOT settled by a bounded quadric point count (the quadric is Theta(n^2), unbounded), so the attack_plan's mechanism is dead; the remaining open count is the subset-(e2,e1) equidistribution of mu_n at the window radius = the generalized-Paley/BGK sup-norm wall.
wall: W-LamLeung / BGK. The e2-face orbit count K reduces to subset-symmetric-function equidistribution over the thin subgroup mu_n at the window-interior radius (incomplete-character-sum cancellation / generalized-Paley sup-norm). The disjointness correctly excludes the antipodal locus but the residual non-antipodal count is the same 25-year-open square-root-cancellation core; the dilation orbit gives the Theta(n) deep-face floor and dilation-quantization, no matching O(1) ceiling. The quadric-point-count route the plan proposed is refuted (count is unbounded).
